values.note: Self-pay, open 24 hours. Campers must occupy the site the first night; after 14 days move to another site for at least 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/golden-lake-campground ('No reservations - first come, first serve.', '24 hours - self pay', 'Camping in a developed recreation site is allowed for a period not longer than 14 days', 'Campers must occupy the site the first night') + recreation.gov search API (https://www.recreation.gov/api/search?lat=46.17415&lng=-88.88109&radius=25): nearest campground listings are Lake Ottawa (14 mi) and Marion Lake group site; no Golden Lake listing, read 2026-10-25

values.note: Scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day. From October 15 (2026) no water or garbage service, but the campground may be used until snow limits access or January 1, whichever comes first.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/golden-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use May 15 – October 15', 'The campground is scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day', 'Reduced services beginning October 15, 2026, no water or garbage services will be provided. Visitors can use the facility until snow conditions reduce access or January 1st, whichever is sooner.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 22 drive-in sites in a single loop that 'can accommodate tents, trailers, and motor homes'; no length limit posted. Each has a picnic table, fire ring, lantern post and parking spur. Up to 8 people, 2 vehicles and one RV or trailer per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/golden-lake-campground ('a single loop with 22 campsites', 'These drive-in campsites can accommodate tents, trailers, and motor homes', 'Eight people and 2 motorized vehicles are allowed per campsite with a maximum of one RV or camper trailer'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One single and one double vault toilet. The page says drinking water is 'Currently unavailable' and 'will be provided in the future', though its amenity list still names a hand pump near the lakeshore north of the boat landing. Free concrete boat ramp, small picnic area and paved parking adjacent.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/golden-lake-campground ('Restrooms Yes 1 single and 1 double vault toilet', 'Potable water is not available at this site. Currently unavailable.', 'Drinking water will be provided in the future', 'Drinking water: Hand pump located near lakeshore-north of the boat landing', 'Boat ramp: No Fee'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground beside Golden Lake (a deep, cold lake stocked with trout and known for its bass), 0.7 mi north of US-2 on FH 16, about midway between Watersmeet and Iron River; Watersmeet/Iron River Ranger District, with the contact listed as Camp Host, LLC. Single loop with natural vegetation between sites. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 5, 2026): 22 drive-in sites for tents/trailers/motorhomes, $16 self-pay, first-come only (no recreation.gov listing), 14-day limit, vault toilets, Senior/Access passes accepted (all confirmed or new). Added season May 15 - Oct 15 (reduced services after, usable until snow or Jan 1) and potable_water false (page: 'Currently unavailable'). Note trimmed of field restatements.
